verdict.rationale: The only spec file found, at /api-reference/openapi.json, is titled "OpenAPI Plant Store". That is a placeholder sample spec, not a machine-readable description of Bento's own API. The standard OpenAPI paths all return 404. Bento's CLI and llms.txt are separate capabilities and do not count as a downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
